notes.title: Exciting News – Trail of Angels Just Got Even Better!
notes.notes:
[h1]Here’s what’s new:[/h1]
⚡ Enhanced Interactivity – We’ve added more interactive stimuli to deepen your immersion and connection with the experience.
⏸️ Pause Functionality – You've asked for it, and it’s here: now you can pause the experience using your controller. When paused, the scene gently fades into a soft blur—waiting for your return.
💸 More Friendly Pricing – We heard your voices and have adjusted the price to make the experience more accessible for everyone.

Thank you to our community for your thoughtful suggestions and continued support. We’re listening—and evolving.

💫 Enjoy an even more powerful and emotional journey through the dreamlike world of Trail of Angels.

notes.title: Meet the Visionary Behind Trail of Angels – A Creator Who Transcends Reality!
notes.notes:
Trail of Angels was inspired by the works of the brilliant Lithuanian composer and painter M.K. Čiurlionis, a true pioneer of abstract art, whose 150th anniversary we celebrate this year. His visionary creations were so ahead of their time that they remain as relevant and captivating today as ever. For us, it is deeply meaningful that after experiencing Trail of Angels, many viewers, still catching their breath, ask us about the source of our inspiration. With great pleasure, we take this opportunity to introduce you to the key paintings that shaped this journey into parallel worlds. We hope that, like us, you will become admirers of his extraordinary talent and timeless genius.

Here are the paintings that were used to create the Trail of Angels VR experience
